svg.text: Grey annotations are not drawn by the app. Scope: Resolution section, Slots tab, 2-D footprint + label rows, loss marks, detection overlay, Resolution menu + progress. Everything else is context, unchanged.
① Details - Unit tab: the RESOLUTION section (ST-0, authored, saved)
drag the footprint's arrow on the map
② Details - SLOTS tab: the slot table (ST-3, live, read-only)
Rows are the unit's slot table (UnitSlotTable, chunked). A down slot stays listed - its wounds survive a split (C-3).
Read-only: losses come only from combat; the instructor's tools are the Unit tab's live actions (unchanged).
③ 2-D map - the FOOTPRINT (ST-1), the label rows, losses (ST-3); ⛔ nothing in 3-D (the unit is hidden)
FOOTPRINT: width x depth x heading
the unit's CARD (⑥): strength bar in place
of health, ammo, name, one info line
LOSS MARK: −n + skull, at the footprint's
COLUMN: a band along its path,
hidden; the 3-D map draws no footprint)
cards drop below 40 px per unit
④ Debug overlay - DETECTION LEVELS (ST-2): Tactical Map Layers ▸ AI ▸ Detection levels
reported (in the squad contact pool, N-2)
hover a line: Pd this step, range, LOS samples
a layer row (AI group), 2-D only, off by default;
⑤ De- / re-aggregate: the request (right-click, ST-5) and the PROGRESS
NEW group (dashed): the instructor's request - SV-14: at once, an instructor order
wins over the policy; writes a ResolutionPin. The menu's other items are unchanged.
while it splits - the map label gains a PROGRESS chip:
the men already MATERIALISED but HELD
(dashed rings, D-P4) - not in the world yet
chip: stage glyph · progress (leaves with posts)
· n/m - gone after the Handover tick
2 of 3 squads posted · 19 of 26 men created · deadline 14 s
⑥ The unit's CARD (2-D and 3-D, the Labels layer): the NATO SYMBOL on the left (UI-12), STRENGTH in place of health - 3 lines max
line 1 - STRENGTH bar (row 10, where a man's health is): present / authorized in the SITREP colour
(green >= 90 %, amber >= 70 %, red); ticks at 70 / 90 %; a thin AMMO bar under it (green >= 50 %, amber >= 25 %, red)
line 2 - the NAME (row 20, unchanged) + ~ in violet = not physical
line 3 - ONE info line (row 64): present/authorized in the strength colour · what it does (teal) · the prepared level
(blue) or ONE alarm, the worst first: BROKEN n (red, skull) > supp nn% (amber) > out of ammo > split n/m; nothing when quiet
Same card machinery and Labels layer as every entity (one card per unit) - in 3-D too, the only place a stochastic unit shows there. Hidden behind terrain like every card.
the SYMBOL cell (UI-12): APP-6 / 2525 frame by side,
the arm icon, echelon marks above - spans the
3 lines; the leader line drops from its centre
⑦ NATO symbols (UI-12): ONE composed renderer - in the card, ALONE on the map when there is no card, in ImGui panels
the vocabulary this programme needs (land units, 2525C function ids, derived - never hand-authored):
The SIDC is DERIVED: side (EntityInfo) + arm and echelon (the unit's DIS type, UnitDis) + mounted (AggregateUnit.Posture); a TKB-authored
SIDC (Symbology §3.8.3c, TextureName) overrides it. Not shown: the stochastic marker - the standard has none; the card's ~ carries it.
zoomed out or Labels off: the SAME symbol ALONE at the unit's point - ONE echelon level per zoom (here companies)
a battalion against a battalion: the frames and the footprints carry the picture; a card returns on hover / selection or when zoomed in
⑧ PROCEDURAL: the symbol is DERIVED from what the unit is made of (UI-12) - vectors, no images, nothing hand-drawn per unit
IFVs carry the men ⇒ MECH. INFANTRY
trucks carry the men ⇒ MOTORISED infantry
men dominate ⇒ INFANTRY, mortars as a secondary mark
⭐ The TKB gains ONE field per system type: SymbolRole (infantry · infantry-carrier · armour · anti-armour · mortar · artillery · recon · HQ · support) and its
mobility (wheeled / tracked, already in UnitHolding.Mobility). Unset ⇒ derived from the type's existing TKB data (a tank platform ⇒ armour, a rifle ⇒ infantry).
⭐ The rule: weigh the AUTHORED content by role ⇒ the dominant role is the ICON; carriers + men ⇒ mechanised (tracked) / motorised (wheeled); a second role
above a share ⇒ the secondary MARK; echelon from AggregateUnit.Echelon / the DIS type. ⚠ From what the unit WAS MADE OF, not what it has left - losing its
IFVs does not turn a mechanised platoon into infantry (identity is stable; the losses are the card's). The same deriver serves a physical unit from its roster.
⑨ ORBAT rows by WHAT the entity is (UI-13) · the layer panel's NATO row (UI-14)
a UNIT: its NATO symbol (the SAME geometry, the ImGui sink) -
a stochastic unit's SLOTS as read-only rows (it has no child
entities) - the Slots tab's icon per role, a down one dimmed
a MAN: by his role - leader crown (amber), the rest the
rifleman (blue); a VEHICLE: by its class (van / truck / tank -
Colour Icons §2); destroyed: dimmed + the red skull / fire
NEW - a unit's APP-6 symbol: in its card's cell, or alone at its point
NATO on + Labels on ⇒ the symbol in the CARD's cell (no second one at the point)
NATO on + Labels off ⇒ the symbol ALONE at the unit's point (the zoomed-out picture)
NATO off ⇒ none: a unit is its card, as today
ONE symbol per UNIT (a squad's for its nine men) - never per man; one echelon level per zoom
Men and vehicles keep their rotated silhouettes ('Entities') - no NATO mode for them (§6 S-8)
